objective: Improve weak-teacher temporal localization on a source-disjoint 82-row dev split while keeping the unfine-tuned Qwen spatial model frozen

data.train: 370 valid temporal rows from the frozen 372-row train split; 335 source groups after excluding two zero-length-label rows
data.dev: 82 rows / 74 source groups; evaluated once after full training
data.holdout: 64 rows remain closed and are not used
data.competition_test: not read, inferred, packaged, or uploaded

model.spatial_policy: keep unfine-tuned Qwen spatial baseline; no spatial training

gates.smoke: 16 independent train sources, exactly 20 optimizer steps; finite loss, zero skipped rows, adapter saved, and one-row new-process reload inference valid
gates.full: only after smoke passes; exactly one epoch over 370 valid train rows
gates.dev_acceptance: group-macro weak F1 improves by at least 0.03 versus frozen BASE, paired 10000-draw source-group bootstrap lower bound > 0, and valid rate is not lower than BASE
gates.failure: keep BASE temporal output and stop; never use OLD_S2 exposure-contaminated metrics as the acceptance gate
